queries.query: دادو سنڌ سرڪاري ڪادستر نقشو زمين رڪارڊ / دادو سندھ سرکاری کادستر نقشہ زمین ریکارڈ
queries.outcome: Official Sindh Zameen/BOR portal found with Sindhi/Urdu service labels; no separate parcel geometry endpoint found.

officialSources.observation: Current official Sindh Zameen landing page identifies the Board of Revenue Sindh public land-record portal and lists Maps/Deh Maps among public services.
Current map index links to the Deh Maps viewer at /map/Sindh_Map.aspx.
Current JavaScript/image-map configuration contains a Dadu district area whose handler routes to Taluka.aspx?district=dadu.
Current Dadu map page identifies District Dadu and exposes Dadu, Johi, Khairpur Nathan Shah, and Mehar taluka map controls.
Official BOR Sindh page identifies the Board as the provincial authority for land-record preparation and cadastral administration.
Official BOR GIS/geodatabase page describes GIS-based land surveying and mapping work, with examples focused on Karachi; it does not expose a Dadu parcel API.

requests.outcome: TLS verification failed because the www host certificate did not match the requested hostname; no certificate exception was used and no data was accepted from this route.
Public portal loaded over verified TLS; HTML and current links inspected.
Map index loaded; Deh Maps route identified.
Current JavaScript/configuration inspected. Dadu district is a map area routed to the Dadu taluka page; this is a scanned/map-image workflow, not an ArcGIS/GeoJSON parcel service.
Dadu district/taluka map page loaded and current JavaScript inspected.

Anonymous bounded JSON response returned an HTML fragment reporting District Dadu, Taluka Dadu, Available Dehs: 62, and a list including Deh Dadu. No parcel IDs, geometry, owner, address, titleholder, tax, CNIC, or other unsafe fields were requested or returned.
Official district GIS page loaded, but its iframe points to a Google My Map for education facilities; it is not a cadastral source and was not used as parcel evidence.

schemaAndCrs.result: No parcel feature schema or parcel geometry CRS was exposed by the inspected public Sindh Zameen map flow.
schemaAndCrs.mapRepresentation: Raster/map-image and server-rendered HTML list controls; no GeoJSON, WFS, ArcGIS FeatureServer, or bounded parcel geometry response observed.

safeFieldAllowlist: district/taluka/deh names needed to establish map scope
scopeLimits: The Dadu response is a bounded administrative/deh-list response, not citywide parcel coverage.
No parcel polygon or stable native parcel ID was found, so no sample GeoJSON was retained.
The exact WUP point [26.7301874720075,67.773619983009] was not shifted and was not used to infer absence or presence.
Portal disclaimers and service pages indicate public-information/procedural limits; legal title, ownership, address, tax, CNIC, contact, and complete record details were not accessed.
Dadu city versus Dadu district/taluka/deh boundaries are not established by the bounded response.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The official source clearly provides Dadu deh-map procedure and a current list of 62 Dadu taluka dehs, but the public route is image/server-rendered and did not expose safe parcel-level vector data. It remains unknown whether parcel vectors exist behind another authenticated, undocumented, or non-public BOR workflow.
note: This review records executed anonymous public requests only. Scratch captures are under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/dadu and are not retained as packet artifacts.
